sources.title: Microsoft Security pricing for small/medium business

keyLimits.en: Annual subscription (auto-renews), up to 300 users, up to 5 devices per user, no minimum device requirement.
Includes Defender for Business plus the full Microsoft 365 productivity suite.

addOns.en: Defender for Business Servers add-on to protect Windows and Linux servers under the same admin console.

cautions.en: Standalone plan is capped at 300 users, so it is not viable for larger organizations without moving to enterprise Defender plans.

capabilities.en: AI-powered endpoint detection and response (EDR) against malware and ransomware.
Automatic attack disruption for human-operated ransomware.
Attack surface reduction: network protection, firewall, reduction rules, web category blocking.
Automated investigation, threat response and vulnerability management, with a simplified setup wizard.

limitations.en: Standalone plan caps out at 300 users and 5 devices per user, unsuitable for larger deployments.
Server protection is a separate paid add-on, not included in the base per-user price.

reason.en: Direct competitor in AI-powered endpoint detection and response for SMBs and enterprises.
Overlaps in the broader SMB security/compliance space, though focused on compliance automation rather than EDR.

missingAlternatives.name: SentinelOne
missingAlternatives.reason: Major AI-driven endpoint protection competitor, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: Whether a free trial is offered for Defender for Business was not confirmed on the pricing page.
